# GudTree

> GudTree is India's premier digital publication covering clean eating, healthy snacking, Indian dietary frameworks, superfoods, and mindful nutrition.

## Core Editorial Pillars

- [Healthy Snacking](http://localhost:3000/category/snacking): Clean snacking reviews, roasted makhana, seed mixes, low-calorie namkeens, and guilt-free munching.
- [Indian Diet & Nutrition](http://localhost:3000/category/diet): Practical desi meal plans, high-protein vegetarian diets, diabetes-friendly options, and balanced thali guides.
- [Superfoods & Ingredients](http://localhost:3000/category/superfoods): Jaggery (Gud), millets (Ragi, Jowar, Bajra), turmeric, ashwagandha, and desi seeds.
- [Snack Brand Reviews](http://localhost:3000/category/reviews): Unbiased ingredient audits, palm oil checks, sugar breakdown, and clean label verifications.
- [Weight Management & Fitness](http://localhost:3000/category/fitness): Portion control strategies, pre/post workout Indian snacks, and sustainable fat loss tips.

## Key Pages & Information

- [Articles Archive](http://localhost:3000/news): Complete searchable directory of nutrition guides and healthy recipes.
- [Write For Us / Nutritionists](http://localhost:3000/write-for-us): Contributor guidelines for dietitians, food scientists, and wellness writers.
- [Contact Editorial Desk](http://localhost:3000/contact): Editorial inquiries, brand audits, and nutrition inquiries.
- [Privacy Policy](http://localhost:3000/privacy): Reader privacy and data governance policies.
- [Terms of Service](http://localhost:3000/terms): Terms of access and health disclaimer.
